description_en: Switches the master role in a cluster to a subordinate HSM. This operation is not supported for manually synchronized clusters in the Chinese mainland
description_zh: 将集群内一台子密码机切换为主密码机。中国内地手动同步集群不支持此接口
kebab_example: aliyun hsm switch-cluster-master --cluster-id cluster-w3G9vOJI20000 --instance-id hsm-cn-vj30bil80000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SwitchClusterMaster

parameters.description_en: The ID of the HSM instance to be set as the master HSM.
parameters.description_zh: 切换为主密码机的密码机实例ID。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the HSM instance to be set as the master HSM
parameters.help_zh: 切换为主密码机的密码机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id
